breakdown.description: `nd0` is built from the `Mg_Ga` defect structure, but it is later used as the Ga-vacancy reference.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still compares `nd0` (built from the Mg_Ga defect structure files) against `v_Ga` for equality and inequality checks. This perpetuates the inconsistency where a Mg_Ga-derived NamedDefect is incorrectly used as the Ga-vacancy reference. The ground truth removes this conflation entirely, simply directing construction of a NamedDefect from the bulk and defect structures without positioning it as a Ga-vacancy reference.
